name: expressjs-API
description: API for use in web projects

paragraphs: A Node.js / Express 5 backend for a small e-commerce style site. It provides user authentication (JWT), a product catalog, a shopping cart, Stripe payments, order management, and a few content endpoints (quotes, design notes, projects, support requests, email subscriptions). Data is stored in MongoDB via Mongoose, and the app is set up to run locally or as a serverless function on Vercel.
features: Authentication – register, login, password reset by email, JWT-protected routes, admin-only routes
Products – CRUD, keyword search, category filter, paginated listing
Cart – add, update, patch quantity, remove, clear, check whether a product is in the cart
Payments – Stripe payment intents and order saving; admins can list all orders
Content endpoints – quotes (including random quote), design notes, CEP projects (with pagination)
